title: C.I.D
overview: Ravi, a dedicated CID officer, embarks on a perilous mission to dismantle a ruthless criminal gang. His investigation unexpectedly leads him down a dark path, culminating in a shocking confrontation with Baba, a legendary and feared gangster. What Ravi discovers is nothing short of devastating: Baba is his long-presumed-dead father, forcing Ravi to confront a past he thought was buried and choose a terrifying path between duty and family.
